descriptor: Speaking-first language app with patient voice tutors

voice.summary: parley sounds like a lively friend who would rather you say something wrong than say nothing. It is sticker-bright and encouraging, using short phrases in the target language with the translation right behind.
dos: Show a real phrase before explaining grammar
Cheer every attempt, even wrong ones
donts: Do not lecture about verb tables

taglines: Speak real sentences on day one
Five minutes to your first chat
Say it badly. Say it today
boilerplate: parley is a language app that gets learners speaking real sentences on day one, with short voice lessons, a patient AI tutor and a daily streak to keep things fun.

microcopy.success: Brilliant. That's 5 days in a row.
microcopy.error: We did not catch that. Try saying it again.
microcopy.empty: No phrases yet. Pick a language to begin.

logo.note: A speech bubble puts conversation at the centre, which is the whole point of the app.
